E.  NEW BUSINESS

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the graduation banner pick
up and Ice Cream Social will be held on September 17, 2024; and the Fall Winter Program Guide will be
sent out in mid September.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that a Neighborhood Safety meeting will be held on
September 4, 2024

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced a Block Party Clean­Up Event on Saturday 14,
2024.
